label: EVALUATION FIXTURES - synthetic ambiguous prompts written for development evaluation. Not real user behavior.

prompts.prompt: I want to test whether my neighborhood can support a bakery that helps busy families. No-ads.
I keep saying I'll learn Spanish.
Our team meetings feel useless lately. I'd prefer not to add more tools.
I want some side income but I can't spend more than $200 to start.
Do something with the empty lot behind our building.
Build something for parents of toddlers. It must not collect children's data.
I'm a nurse and I'm tired.
Start a newsletter about local politics, but I only have two hours a week.
Help me get fit. It has to work without a gym.
I maintain an open source library and nobody contributes.
Reduce food waste at my restaurant. We must not buy or install new equipment.
I think I have a book in me.
Help the elderly people on my street. No-contact with their families unless they ask.
Our no-code SaaS loses users after the first week.
Should I move to Berlin?
Start a running club. No fees and no-alcohol events.
Make school lunches better at my kid's school without asking the school for money.
My design portfolio isn't getting me interviews.
Grow my podcast. I must not run ads, I can sell merch.
Our lab needs a better way to share data before the grant review in March.
